record.name: AI Architecture Render
record.offering: Graphics & Design app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Turn sketches, model views, photos and floor plans into architectural concepts — then refine a result you love.

YOUR DESIGN STUDIO

Sketch / Design to Render
Bring a sketch, line drawing or untextured 3D model screenshot to life.

Render Interior & Exterior
Explore finishes, furnishing, lighting and architectural atmosphere from your own source image.

Furnish Empty Room
Visualize an empty room with furniture, textiles and decor in a coherent design style.

Redesign Facade
Explore cladding, colors, finishes and entrance details for an existing building.

Garden & Landscape
Visualize planting, patios, paths and outdoor seating for gardens, courtyards and terraces.

Change Materials
Explore a new floor, wall finish or facade palette. Add your own instructions and brush marks to guide the area to change.

Restyle My Render
Explore another design language using a photo or existing render.

Change Lighting
Explore bright daylight, soft overcast light, golden hour or a night-time atmosphere.

Presentation Styles
Transform architecture into watercolor, pencil, marker or collage illustrations.

Sketch to Plan, Color & Furnish Plan, Render from Plan
Create drafted-looking plans, colored presentation plans, or an inferred interior view from a viewpoint placed on a floor plan.

REFINE, COMPARE, PRESENT

Edit a selected render instead of starting again. Describe a change, replace furniture, add planting or mark an object to remove. Brush marks guide the AI; precise edit boundaries may vary.

Add an optional reference image for a material palette or design mood. Your source image remains the subject.

Generate one render or three design options. Each option is generated separately; the total credit cost is shown before you start. Compare the results and export a presentation board as an image or PDF.

Continue saved projects with their source images and settings. Browse 45 illustrated inspiration pages and start a render with a selected style, space, lighting mood or material palette.

PLANS OR YOUR OWN KEY

Render with credits: Monthly includes 30 credits per month; Pro includes 100. One-time packs of 15 or 50 credits do not expire. A Standard render uses 1 credit; High uses 3. Three options use three times the per-render credits. No OpenAI account is needed when using credits.

Alternatively, bring your own OpenAI API key. It is stored in your device's Keychain, and each image generation is billed directly to your OpenAI account.

Projects and images are saved on your device. Optional Sign in with Apple lets you recover your credit account on another device. Our render server temporarily holds completed results so interrupted requests can be recovered.

SUBSCRIPTIONS

Monthly and Pro renew automatically until cancelled. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation and renewal unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the period ends. Manage subscriptions in your App Store account settings. Monthly credits reset at renewal and do not roll over.

AI CONCEPT VISUALIZATIONS

AI interprets your images; it does not reconstruct a measured 3D model. Faithful controls instruct it to preserve the design, but details and proportions can change. Check results against your drawings. Plans are raster images, not CAD files; dimensions are illustrative. Views inferred from plans are approximate.

Selected source and reference images, edit marks and descriptions are sent to OpenAI for processing, after your consent.

record.offering: Graphics & Design app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
YOUR FLOOR PLAN. MORE POSSIBILITIES.

AI Architecture Plan is a workspace for exploring floor plans on iPhone and iPad. Start with a drawing, a scanned plan or a sketch. Refine its presentation, rethink how the interior works, arrange furniture and explore the spaces your plan could become.

WORK WITH YOUR PLAN
• Add Plan Details — refine wall linework, door swings and existing labels.
• Sketch to Plan — turn a hand-drawn layout into a clean-looking 2D plan image.
• Rethink Interior Plan — explore furniture arrangements, activity zones and circulation, with walls kept in place by default.
• Remove Furniture — clear loose furniture while retaining walls, openings and fixed fixtures.
• Add 2D Furniture — add top-down line symbols for seating, beds, tables and storage.

BRING PLANS INTO VIEW
• Render Plan & Materials — explore colour, floor finishes and furniture in a top-down presentation plan.
• Render from Plan — position a viewing cone on your plan and generate a view from that direction.
• Sketch / Design to Render — develop a sketch or model view into a rendered concept.

- View models in augmented reality.

-Import: SKP, SKE, SKM, HDR, EXR, PNG, JPG, PDF, DWG, DXF, STL
-Export: Images (PNG), Animations (MP4), SKP, USDz, PDF, DWG, DXF, OBJ, STL, MP4

Create 3D designs with a free 7-day Go trial. Payment will be charged to your Apple Account on confirmation of purchase. Your subscription will automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before your subscription expiration date. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before your subscription expiration date. After completing your initial purchase, you can manage your subscription and/or turn off auto-renew by visiting your Apple Account Settings.

record.description_evidence:
An outstanding home design app that can turn anyone into a designer. Create detailed floor plan layouts, 3D home design visualizations, plan a garden and work with the surrounding landscape—everything is possible with Live Home 3D Pro.

Floor Plans, Building and Terrain: 
• Сreate detailed 2D floor plan layouts. 
• View real-time dimensions for walls, ceilings and floors when drawing in the 2D Plan view.
• Get unlimited floor levels: you will be able to create multi-story buildings and even skyscrapers.
• Design from scratch or rely on ready-made house and interior design samples (e.g., kitchens, bathrooms, living rooms, etc).
• Work with terrain editing tools for landscape design: create elaborate terrain around your house, lay paths and driveways and plan out your garden or backyard.
• Choose from the ready-made roof templates (12 roofs and 16 dormers) or customize the roof by editing its segments to create roofs of any form and complexity. 
• Work in 2D Elevation view that displays the side view on walls and roof, a perfect tool for working with openings, niches and wall panels. 
• Scan your room or house using the Room Scanner feature based on LiDAR technology to recreate its digital copy (only for devices with LiDAR sensors built-in).
• Use a multi-purpose Building Block tool to create porches, custom columns, beams or even furniture.
• Bosch laser measure integration: take accurate measurements with a laser measure, and easily transfer and apply them to objects.

Objects and Materials: 
• Add and move furniture and other objects (5,000+ items), and apply physically based materials (3,000+ supplied materials). 
• Access thousands of free models that can be imported from the Trimble 3D Warehouse and Sketchfab.
• Import 3D models from other applications in most popular formats (COLLADA, FBX, OBJ, USDZ, 3DS, glTF / glb, etc.)
• Create sophisticated custom materials, and control their texture and light emissive properties using the Material Editor. 

Lighting Settings: 
• Work with natural lighting by setting up true geolocation, time of day and cloudiness.
• Adjust light fixtures throughout the house to achieve a realistic lighting scene.
• Create custom lamps or achieve the best lighting for your projects with Light Source Editor.

Viewing and Sharing Your Project:
• Walk through your 3D interior designs.
• Project your 3D home into real-world surroundings, and even walk around or inside the house using View in the AR option.
• Create flyover videos and 3D renderings of your projects from different angles.
• Seamlessly share your projects among iOS, iPadOS, visionOS, macOS or Windows devices.

Export:
• Export 2D floor plans as PDF and 3D views of your projects as high-resolution images.
• Export the entire house design or several objects to USDZ, glTF, SCN, SCNZ, FBX or OBJ format.
• Get highly realistic views of your designs with the Cycles offline rendering engine (unlimited number of renders at no extra cost).
• Export fast and high quality AI renders of your designs: choose from a multitude of presets and adjust simple settings.
• Get Ultra HD export quality for movies and 360° Panoramas and Hi-res (16,000 x 16,000) for still shots.
• Create Stereo 3D Video, 360° Video, Stereo 3D 360° Video and 360° Panorama JPEG images.

Note: Starting with Live Home 3D version 5.0, you can create an app account and link all your in-app purchases to it, sharing them across all available platforms without re-buying.

ArcSite is the perfect design tool for all levels, from beginners sketching out floor plans to experienced professionals taking on complex projects. No matter your experience, ArcSite puts intuitive CAD within everyone's reach.

ArcSite goes beyond design: start with a drawing to capture data, calculate material quantities, and instantly create estimates and job reports in one place.

- *AI Trace: Sketch it, scan it, see your space. Turn a hand sketch, photo, or PDF into an editable, to-scale floor plan. *only available for iPad; iPhone features coming soon
- Advanced 2D CAD-level precision without the CAD learning curve.
- Create plans from a map: Start a new drawing using a satellite image as your base. Enter an address to find a location, then zoom in or out to set boundaries; the scale will be set automatically.
- Designed for everyone: Easy for first-time users, precise enough for professionals.
- Export, Cloud sync, and collaborate: Your room design drawings export to PNG/PDF/DXF/DWG, save to the cloud, and (for professional users) flow directly into material takeoffs, estimates, and signed proposals.
- Send proposals: Access Proposal Generation (based on your drawing).
- Communicate visual context: Add location-based photos with markup to highlight project issues instantly for teams or customers.

WORK FASTER & STAY ORGANIZED WITH FIELD-LEVEL PRECISION
- Keep all of your project details in one place.
- Customize products, forms, material types, quantity calculations, and pricing to match your data requirements.
- Our mobile CAD app offers unmatched accuracy, whether with exact-to-scale drawings or quantities of materials and pricing.
- Draw to scale with confidence: Our mobile CAD app makes it easy to get accurate measurements and pricing, every time.
- Security - SOC 2 Type II compliant and ISO/IEC 27001 certified.

SMART FEATURES FOR CREATING FLOOR PLANS
- *AR Room Scanner: Scan a room or space with your phone or iPad camera and get a scaled floor plan placed directly in the drawing canvas, no manual measuring. *only for Apple Pro devices
- Smart Shapes and parametric objects: Walls, doors, windows, and shapes can snap into place, auto-count, and adjust as you draw or resize.
- Quick-start template gallery: Pre-built templates save you time.

WHO USES ARCSITE?
- Sales Teams
- Residential Contractors
- Fencing Pros
- Foundation Repair Experts
- Designers, Architects
- Creative Homeowners
- Remodeling Pros
- Inspectors
- Auditors
- General Contractors
- And more
